convertibility_reason: Uses a custom signal filter class CBE_BE_MFI from an external .mqh library (ACBE_BE_MFI.mqh), which implements custom indicator logic not available as a standard MT5 built-in indicator.

derived_values.name: Signal weighted vote from CBE_BE_MFI filter

other_exits: Signal threshold close: CExpertSignal closes position when weighted signal falls below Signal_ThresholdClose (20)
Pending order expiration after 4 bars if price does not reach Signal_PriceLevel

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CMoneyFixedLot uses Money_FixLot_Lots as fixed lot size; Money_FixLot_Percent (10.0) used as risk fraction for margin validation

custom_logic_notes: The core trading signal is encapsulated in the CBE_BE_MFI class from ACBE_BE_MFI.mqh. This class implements a composite signal based on MFI (Market Facilitation Index) smoothed by a moving average. The exact entry/exit conditions (crossover logic, threshold comparison) are inside this custom class and cannot be fully extracted without reading the .mqh source. The EA uses the standard CExpert framework with weighted signal voting — the filter's Weight (1.0) is multiplied by its directional result and compared against threshold values. Expert_EveryTick=false means the EA evaluates signals only once per bar, not on every tick. SL and TP are both set to 0, meaning the CExpert framework may generate SL/TP from the signal module's LongCondition/ShortCondition methods or there is no explicit SL/TP protection.
python_conversion_notes: The CBE_BE_MFI signal filter logic must be reverse-engineered from ACBE_BE_MFI.mqh before Python conversion is possible. The MFI indicator is available in Python via pandas_ta or ta-lib (MFI uses typical price and volume). However, the specific BE (Bill Williams) logic combining MFI with MA may have non-standard conditions. The CExpert signal voting mechanism (weight * direction vs threshold) needs to be reimplemented manually. Position sizing is straightforward fixed lot. No SL/TP simplifies conversion. New-bar guard (EveryTick=false) maps to a bar-change check in Python. Pending order expiration (4 bars) would need a bar counter in the Python implementation.
